ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; predominantly low-intensity dark pixels (estimated >90%) with isolated high-intensity white pixel clusters and one prominent linear streak.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity vertical linear feature located on the mid-distal region of the left lobe; sparse white punctate clusters distributed across the basal region of both lobes near the waterline; faint grey-scale mottling on the right lobe interior surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression with shallow depth; notch is visible but lacks sharp definition at the vertex due to water-level occlusion.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations on the left lobe; right lobe exhibits larger, high-amplitude irregular peaks and valleys increasing in magnitude towards the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory observed on both the left and right lobes extending from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense cluster of high-contrast, roughly circular pixel formations (barnacles) concentrated on the distal tip of the right lobe; secondary sparse white circular points visible on the lower interior of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical high-intensity linear mark on the left lobe; multiple faint, parallel, near-horizontal linear disruptions on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural irregularity and calcified clusters on the right fluke tip; multiple jagged missing tissue sections (notches) along the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent bulbous protrusion on the right distal tip caused by high-density colonization of external organisms.
